about_the_game:
Portal: Intrusion is a fan-made mod for Portal 2, running off of Portal 2: Community Edition.

Intrusion will include:

  • An original OST

  • Multiple hours of gameplay.

  • An original story, presenting a darker take on the usual lighthearted tone of the Portal series.

  • Many new mechanics.

  • Many new perplexing puzzles.

  • Combat, similar to Half-Life 2.

And more.

When will Intrusion be released?

Intrusion is nowhere near completed, the release date cannot be pinned down yet.

How long is Intrusion?

Intrusion is too early in development to pin down the length. However, we're aiming for several hours of play time. (This may wildly vary between the skills of different players.)

Do I need Portal 2 to play?

Yes, Intrusion runs on Portal 2: Community Edition, which requires that you own Portal 2 to play. You will not need either Portal 2, or Community Edition installed to play. You will only need to own Portal 2.

Will the soundtrack be released?

Yes, it will be out shortly after Intrusion releases. You can use it wherever you want, as long as you please remember to credit it.

How can I help develop Intrusion?

Join the Discord server.

Portal: Intrusion is a mod for Portal 2. Set after the events of Portal 2, unknown threats are detected above Aperture Laboratories, you are tasked with defending the facility by GLaDOS. However, a core breaks you out of a testing track designed to train you for combat. But the jailbreak goes awry, and your only goal is to secure your freedom. But even the most well devised plans may have unforeseen consequences.

Puzzle Mechanics

Portal: Intrusion will introduce new mechanics, old mechanics, and scrapped mechanics.

This includes, but is not limited to:

  • Pneumatic Diversity Vent

  • Schrödinger's Cube

  • Supercharged Portal Gun

  • High Energy Pellets

INTRUSION IS IN ACTIVE DEVELOPMENT. ALL CONTENT LISTED ABOVE IS SUBJECT TO CHANGE.

legal_notice: Portal: Intrusion is made by fans, it is in no way associated with Valve. Intrusion is powered by the community made Source Engine branch: Portal 2: Community Edition, and uses Valve's IPs: Portal, Half-Life.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Linux kernel version 4.10 or greater
  • Processor: Any x64 CPU with at least 4 cores
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Video card with 2GB memory and Vulkan 1.3 support
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Steam Deck compatibility is planned. Minimum requirements subject to change.
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Linux kernel version 4.10 or greater
  • Processor: Recent x64 CPU with 4+ cores
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Video card with 8GB memory and Vulkan 1.3 support
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
